comment:
* Class to track various latencies in SystemUI. It then writes the latency to statsd and also * outputs it to logcat so these latencies can be captured by tests and then used for dashboards. *

* This is currently only in Keyguard. It can be shared between SystemUI and Keyguard, but * eventually we'd want to merge these two packages together so Keyguard can use common classes * that are shared with SystemUI.

variables.name: DEFAULT_ENABLED
variables.comment: Default to being enabled on debug builds.

variables.name: DEFAULT_SAMPLING_INTERVAL
variables.comment: Default to collecting data for 1/5 of all actions (randomly sampled).

variables.name: ACTION_EXPAND_PANEL
variables.comment: * Time it takes until the first frame of the notification panel to be displayed while expanding

variables.name: ACTION_TOGGLE_RECENTS
variables.comment: * Time it takes until the first frame of recents is drawn after invoking it with the button.

variables.name: ACTION_FINGERPRINT_WAKE_AND_UNLOCK
variables.comment: * Time between we get a fingerprint acquired signal until we start with the unlock animation

variables.name: ACTION_CHECK_CREDENTIAL
variables.comment: * Time it takes to check PIN/Pattern/Password.

variables.name: ACTION_CHECK_CREDENTIAL_UNLOCKED
variables.comment:
* Time it takes to check fully PIN/Pattern/Password, i.e. that's the time spent including the
     * actions to unlock a user.

variables.name: ACTION_TURN_ON_SCREEN
variables.comment: * Time it takes to turn on the screen.

variables.name: ACTION_ROTATE_SCREEN
variables.comment: * Time it takes to rotate the screen.

variables.name: ACTION_FACE_WAKE_AND_UNLOCK
variables.comment: * Time between we get a face acquired signal until we start with the unlock animation

variables.name: ACTION_START_RECENTS_ANIMATION
variables.comment: * Time between the swipe-up gesture and window drawn of recents activity.

variables.name: ACTION_ROTATE_SCREEN_CAMERA_CHECK
variables.comment: * Time it takes to for the camera based algorithm to rotate the screen.

variables.name: ACTION_ROTATE_SCREEN_SENSOR
variables.comment: * Time it takes the sensor to detect rotation.

variables.name: ACTION_LOCKSCREEN_UNLOCK
variables.comment: * Time it takes to start unlock animation .

variables.name: ACTION_USER_SWITCH
variables.comment: * Time it takes to switch users.

variables.name: ACTION_SWITCH_DISPLAY_UNFOLD
variables.comment: * Time it takes to turn on the inner screen for a foldable device.

variables.name: ACTION_UDFPS_ILLUMINATE
variables.comment: * Time it takes for a UDFPS sensor to appear ready after it is touched.

variables.name: ACTION_SHOW_BACK_ARROW
variables.comment: * Time it takes for the gesture back affordance arrow to show up.

variables.name: ACTION_LOAD_SHARE_SHEET
variables.comment: * Time it takes for loading share sheet.

variables.name: ACTION_SHOW_SELECTION_TOOLBAR
variables.comment: * Time it takes for showing the selection toolbar.

variables.name: ACTION_FOLD_TO_AOD
variables.comment: * Time it takes to show AOD display after folding the device.

variables.name: ACTION_SHOW_VOICE_INTERACTION
variables.comment:
* Time it takes to show the {@link android.service.voice.VoiceInteractionSession} system UI
     * after a {@link android.hardware.soundtrigger3.ISoundTriggerHw} voice trigger.

variables.name: ACTION_REQUEST_IME_SHOWN
variables.comment: * Time it takes to request IME shown animation.

variables.name: ACTION_REQUEST_IME_HIDDEN
variables.comment: * Time it takes to request IME hidden animation.

variables.name: ACTION_SMARTSPACE_DOORBELL
variables.comment:
* Time it takes to load the animation frames in smart space doorbell card.
     * It measures the duration from the images uris are passed into the view
     * to all the frames are loaded.
     * <p/>
     * A long latency makes the doorbell animation looks janky until all the frames are loaded.

variables.name: ACTION_NOTIFICATION_BIG_PICTURE_LOADED
variables.comment:
* Time it takes to lazy-load the image of a {@link android.app.Notification.BigPictureStyle}
     * notification.

variables.name: ACTION_KEYGUARD_FPS_UNLOCK_TO_HOME
variables.comment: * Time it takes to unlock the device via udfps, until the whole launcher appears.

variables.name: ACTION_BACK_SYSTEM_ANIMATION
variables.comment: * Time it takes to start back preview surface animation after a back gesture starts.

variables.name: ACTION_NOTIFICATIONS_HIDDEN_FOR_MEASURE
variables.comment:
* Time notifications spent in hidden state for performance reasons. We might temporary
     * hide notifications after display size changes (e.g. fold/unfold of a foldable device)
     * and measure them while they are hidden to unblock rendering of the rest of the UI.

variables.name: ACTION_NOTIFICATIONS_HIDDEN_FOR_MEASURE_WITH_SHADE_OPEN
variables.comment:
* The same as {@link ACTION_NOTIFICATIONS_HIDDEN_FOR_MEASURE} but tracks time only
     * when the notifications are hidden and when the shade is open or keyguard is visible.

methods.comment:

During testing, a {@link LatencyTracker} it is desired to stop and start listening for * config updates. * *

This is not used for production usages of this class outside of testing as we are * using a single static object.
